steps.sql: SELECT CHOOSE(2, 'a', 'b', 'c') AS c0, CHOOSE(4, 'a', 'b', 'c') AS c1, CHOOSE(0, 'a', 'b') AS c2, CHOOSE(NULL, 'a', 'b') AS c3
SELECT CHOOSE(1, 1, 2.5) AS c0, CHOOSE(2, 'a', N'bb') AS c1, CHOOSE(1, CAST('x' AS varchar(3)), CAST('yy' AS varchar(10))) AS c2
SELECT CHOOSE(2.9, 'a', 'b', 'c') AS c0, CHOOSE('2', 'a', 'b') AS c1, CHOOSE(1, NULL, 'b') AS c2
SELECT CHOOSE(1, 'a', 2) AS c0
SELECT CHOOSE(1, 2, 'a') AS c0
SELECT CHOOSE(1) AS c0
SELECT CHOOSE(1, CAST('2024-01-01' AS date), '2024-02-02') AS c0
SELECT GREATEST(1, 2, 3) AS c0, LEAST(1, 2, 3) AS c1, GREATEST(1, 2.5) AS c2, LEAST(CAST(1 AS bigint), 2) AS c3
SELECT GREATEST('a', 'b', 'C') AS c0, LEAST(N'a', 'B') AS c1, GREATEST(CAST('a' AS varchar(3)), CAST('bb' AS varchar(10))) AS c2
SELECT GREATEST(1, NULL, 3) AS c0, LEAST(NULL, NULL) AS c1, GREATEST(NULL) AS c2, LEAST(5) AS c3
SELECT GREATEST(CAST('2024-01-01' AS date), '2024-05-05') AS c0, LEAST(1.5, CAST(2 AS float)) AS c1, GREATEST(CAST(1 AS money), 2) AS c2
SELECT GREATEST(1, 'a') AS c0
SELECT GREATEST(1, '5') AS c0, LEAST('10', 9) AS c1
SELECT GREATEST(CAST(1.25 AS decimal(5,2)), CAST(100.5 AS decimal(10,1))) AS c0
SELECT GREATEST(0x01, 0x02) AS c0
SELECT ISNUMERIC('123') AS c0, ISNUMERIC('12.5') AS c1, ISNUMERIC('abc') AS c2, ISNUMERIC(NULL) AS c3, ISNUMERIC('') AS c4
SELECT ISNUMERIC('$12') AS c0, ISNUMERIC('1e5') AS c1, ISNUMERIC('-') AS c2, ISNUMERIC('+') AS c3, ISNUMERIC('.') AS c4, ISNUMERIC(',') AS c5
SELECT ISNUMERIC('1,000') AS c0, ISNUMERIC(' 12 ') AS c1, ISNUMERIC('1d2') AS c2, ISNUMERIC('0x10') AS c3, ISNUMERIC('$') AS c4, ISNUMERIC('\') AS c5
SELECT ISNUMERIC(12) AS c0, ISNUMERIC(1.5) AS c1, ISNUMERIC(CAST(1 AS bit)) AS c2, ISNUMERIC(CAST(1 AS money)) AS c3
SELECT ISNUMERIC(CAST('2024-01-01' AS date)) AS c0
SELECT ISNUMERIC('1e') AS c0, ISNUMERIC('e5') AS c1, ISNUMERIC('1.2.3') AS c2, ISNUMERIC(CHAR(9) + '1') AS c3, ISNUMERIC('£5') AS c4, ISNUMERIC('€5') AS c5
SELECT ISNUMERIC('1E+308') AS c0, ISNUMERIC('1E+309') AS c1, ISNUMERIC('99999999999999999999999999999999999999999') AS c2, ISNUMERIC('-$5') AS c3, ISNUMERIC('$-5') AS c4
SELECT IIF(1 = 1, 'a', 'b') AS c0, IIF(NULL = 1, 1, 2) AS c1, IIF(1 = 2, 1, 2.5) AS c2
SELECT NULLIF(1, 1) AS c0, NULLIF('a', 'b') AS c1, NULLIF(1, 1.0) AS c2, ISNULL(NULL, 5) AS c3, COALESCE(NULL, 2, 3) AS c4
SELECT NEWSEQUENTIALID() AS c0
SELECT CASE WHEN NEWID() IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS c0, DATALENGTH(NEWID()) AS c1
SELECT CASE WHEN GETDATE() IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS c0, CASE WHEN SYSDATETIME() IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS c1
SELECT TOP 0 GETDATE() AS a, GETUTCDATE() AS b, SYSDATETIME() AS c, SYSUTCDATETIME() AS d, SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AS e, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS f, NEWID() AS g
SELECT TOP 0 RAND() AS a, @@DATEFIRST AS b, DB_NAME() AS c, HOST_NAME() AS d, SUSER_SNAME() AS e, USER_NAME() AS f
